name: apple-mail-mcp
description: Apple Mail, Calendar and Notes for your AI assistant — read, search, triage and send, locally, with zero dependencies.
long_description: Runs on JavaScript for Automation (osascript), which ships with macOS: no Node, Python or Homebrew. Two tools — `read` (never changes anything) and `write` (send, reply, forward, organize, rules, events, notes) — so you approve permissions twice, not thirty times. Finds emails waiting for your reply and sent emails nobody answered.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide the write tool: the assistant can read and search but never send, move, delete or create anything.

default_account.title: Default Mail account
default_account.description: Account name as shown in Apple Mail (e.g. Work). Used when the assistant doesn't name one.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read Mail, Calendar and Notes: inbox, search, threads, attachments, emails awaiting reply or needing your response, rules, events, notes.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Send, reply, forward; flag, mark read, move, delete to Trash; folders and rules; save attachments; calendar events; notes.
